q1.question: What is BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)?
q1.answer: BYOK means you connect your own AI API key (from OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google). This way, you pay only for your actual usage - typically $3-5/month - instead of expensive monthly subscriptions.

q2.question: How much does AI usage actually cost?
q2.answer: Most users spend $3-5/month on AI API costs. That's 90-95% less than traditional AI content tools that charge $50+ monthly subscriptions.

q3.question: Will the AI sound like me?
q3.answer: Yes! Our AI learns from your previous posts and writing samples. After training, it captures your unique voice, tone, and style - your audience won't know the difference.

q4.question: Can I try before committing?
q4.answer: Absolutely! Our Free plan includes 3 posts per month with full BYOK support. No credit card required to start.

q5.question: What's the 30% founder's discount?
q5.answer: Early access members lock in 30% off for their entire first year. This discount applies to any paid plan and is only available during pre-launch.
